title: Sunk cost
src: Arkes and Blumer, The Psychology of Sunk Cost, 1985
idea: Time and money already spent and gone should not decide what you do next.
apply: Ask: if I were starting today with nothing spent, would I choose this? If the answer is no, stop.
remind: What is spent is gone. Choose from here.
who: Sam, eight months into an app nobody pays for.

scenes.cap: and 8 months spent on an app
scenes.nar: Sam has spent eight months and three thousand dollars building an app.
Twelve people tried it. Two came back. Nobody paid. Still, Sam keeps going, because quitting would waste everything already spent.

items: The money is gone either way

blocks.h: Starting today with nothing spent, would I choose this?

scenes.nar: So Sam asks a different question. If I were starting today with nothing spent, would I choose this project?
The honest answer is no. Sam shelves the app and spends the next month talking to customers about what they actually need.
